owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

title: PGP-1.06.3 memev-ops: SR-3.01 and SR-3.03 superseded by the call-out engine decision, SR-3.05 states the licences once
request: Version 2 of PGP-1.06, under the id PGP-1.06.3 because the record of PGP-1.06.2 was refused: it supersedes the signed contract k-pgp-1-06-memev-ops-sr-3-d345d7; that file is unchanged and stays on record. Reason: the owner decision of 5 Nov 2026 (docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md, "Owner decisions of 5 November 2026: the paid engine") replaces one line of ADR 6: one private repository, memev-merge, is allowed as the package around crdt-merge, holding the provider shim, the integration of E4 and the signed programs, with no merge algorithm of its own. The changes from version 1 are: T1 requirement 2 and two T1 criteria, one that SR-3.03 states what the package is and one that it no longer says no such repository is created; T2 requirement 1 and the SR-3.05 text and criterion on counsel, which now record the owner's decision of 5 Nov 2026 to replace a lawyer's review with engineering controls, the remaining risk being his; and the marking of the 31 Oct tiers as superseded. PR 13 lands with this version, not version 1. SR-3.01 and SR-3.03 stay superseded and are not built or re-signed in their earlier form. Per-pull-request contract for memev-ops, branch docs/engine-decision-sr3. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs after the red-team gate. Repository: memev-ops (paths relative to that repository; the contract lives in the memev contracts tree). Programme tasks WP05-02 and WP15-02 (ops side). Boundary with SO-2.13: this contract states licences and the call-out decision; the commercial service boundary stays in SO-2.13. The canonical seed-readiness manifest is the one in memev-ops (103 contracts); the memev copy holds a subset and is kept identical for SR-3.01 and SR-3.05. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply (the engine decision confirmed by the owner, t542u): crdt-merge stays in its own repository (BSL 1.1 with its PATENTS file) and is reached only across the call-out boundary, never vendored, so inclusion cannot relicense it; the 31 Oct tiers (free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers) are superseded by the owner decisions of 5 Nov 2026 and contract PL-1, and no criterion here tests a price; no Federated tier and no separate Personal trial; federation is planned, not available. Depends on contracts: none. Signed vault contract WO-05-E (cited by id only): SR-3.05 states the licences once; the signed text guard of the two licence pages stays as it is.
